column6: System updates cassette note counts in FE/SIBS, prints replenishment audit receipt, and updates machine status to In-Service.

column4:
1. Machine in Supervisor mode.
2. Existing cash in cassettes.
column5: Select Cash Clear / Unload > Confirm cash removal from cassettes
column6: System zeroes out cassette note counters, updates SIBS/Host balance, and prints Cash Clear audit report.

column3: Execute Test Cash Dispense / Test Cash Physical Cycle
column4:
1. Cash loaded in cassettes.
2. Machine in Supervisor mode.
column5: Select Diagnostics / Test Dispense > Select cassette > Enter test quantity (e.g., 2 notes) > Confirm
column6: Dispenser cycles notes cleanly into reject/test tray without updating customer account balances or SIBS counters.

column4:

2. Supervisor logged in.
column5: Select Reject/Retract Bin Management > Select Clear Bin Counter > Confirm
column6: System resets reject/retract bin counter to 0 and logs event in supervisor audit log.

column4:
1. Supervisor logged in.
2. Audit logs present.
column5: Select Reports / Audit Log > Select date range / Shift > Select Print Report
column6: Physical audit receipt printed containing total deposits, total withdrawals, and current cassette balances.

column6: Machine transitions to customer home screen and sets status to In-Service in FE & SIBS.

column3: Switch ATM Status from In-Service to Out-of-Service
